column1: # Words that are missing from bendingar.fo, written by Annika Simonsen.
# Same format as KRISTINsnid.csv (15 columns, separated by semicolons).
# The build (tools/binpack.py) reads this file after KRISTINsnid.csv.
# Word ids (column 2) start at 900001, well above the bendingar.fo ids
# (highest: 587987), so they cannot clash with them.
# hjálpa (900001): forms made from the pattern of "dýpa" (bendingar id
# 553492), which has the same endings (-i, -ir, -ti, -t, -tur). The
# corpus (Sosialurin) has hjálpa, hjálpir, hjálpti, hjálptu and hjálpt.
